message: Scaled 2 of 4 spindle speeds to 90 %; 2 tapping speeds left as written.

findings.message: S500 is the speed of a tapping block (M29). A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.

S450 is the speed of a tapping block (G84). A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.
